horoscopes.horoscope: Today finds you in a horrible dilemma – caught between you beloved and your boss. You can’t bear to displease either one of them. However, Ganesha says sometimes you have to smilingly tackle such dilemmas. Take heart, life generally doesn’t give you what you can’t control. You may turn into a party freak in the evening. It’s time to let your hair down and enjoy a great time with friends. You may not forget your loved one and keep in touch with your sweetheart. You will feel happy to bring the smile on your partner’s face. Ganesha feels that despite some issues you’ll be able to achieve all the targets. Work front will be occupied, hence you’ll be more focused on finishing the pending tasks. Your work shall be praised, therefore you’ll be in good mood now. Health looks good today. Ganesha feels that in the first half of the day, trend of the previous day will dominate. You will tend to be pragmatic about money. You shall rethink most aspects related to your investments. The hard work you do today will give you satisfaction. If you feel your colleague can help you finish a certain task quickly there is no harm in taking his/her assistance. Ensure that you don’t spend your valuable time gossiping, feels Ganesha.

This is a day when you will be dying to share your thoughts and feelings with someone near and dear. You will be extremely effective in communicating your ideas and emotions and will thus develop greater closeness and intimacy with your loved one. The time spent with your sweetheart will be full of love and warmth. With Ganesha’s blessings you won’t feel the slightest distress or discomfort today. You may not plan any new exciting romantic activity. However, things seem quite smooth on the relationship front, says Ganesha. Managing the emotional stress will be easy. You may get the things you wanted from your sweetheart. You should learn to be flexible. You may want to complete the pending tasks at workplace. Ganesha advises you to be polite as it may help to improve relations at work. It’s a good day from health point of view. Try to finish one work at a time. Today you shall be able to remain focused on work. You will think seriously about how to increase your business, or how better you can contribute to your company. Stick to the customary path at work as taking the rare paths is risky. Being patient with your superiors will prove beneficial. Success will be yours, but don’t let this success get to your head. You may lose whatever you have gained, feels Ganesha.

You will be worried on account of financial matters, or due to matters related to inheritances. You will become more possessive about material things today and will not be in the mood to share with others. You will feel some satisfaction looking back at your efforts made throughout the day, in the evening, says Ganesha. If you are single, then no need to worry about your love life since in the relationship, Ganesha feels that you will succeed in clarifying the misunderstandings, if any. You will be in an imaginative mood and an dreamy evening with your loved one will make the day. You may handle awkward situations today, feels Ganesha. There could be a conflict between heart and mind. This could cause confusions. However, you should remain very firm. There is possibility of health issues as well. It may not be a good day for you. In first half of the day, your thinking will be more pessimistic but in the second half of the day, you will be very optimistic. Your entire view about finances is going to change, which will ‘recharge’ you. You will come across a few matters where compromise is needed. You may even feel you are being compelled to do your tasks. You will feel that you need to secure your future and financial matters. You may take part in the meeting but should not involve in the decision-making.

You may face a hurdle, as you tend to intervene in others’ matters. But your tact will save you from any untoward incident. By evening, a good news from your kin or intimate friends will cheer you up. If you want no complaints from your partner’s side, all you have to do is to keep your mouth shut and forgive. If you want to express something to your sweetheart, just go ahead. However, you have to speak sweet words with your beloved. The day could pose you several challenges. You may get more demand from both personal and pofessional life. This could make you tired. According to Ganesha, the day is going to be an average one with not good mood and health conditions. You will learn that only closest ones help or say, those who help you – consider them the closest ones. Towards end of the day, financial depression and depression due to finances is foreseen. Today you may feel that every person you come across is being very demanding. Meeting all these demands may not be easy. You may have to be mentally strong. Keep patience and have faith in you. Slowly but steadily, you will find a progress.

You will take important decisions relating to some partnership today. A progressive day at the workplace awaits. Traders may face some financial constraints however. The stress of over-work may tie you down. So do not bite off more than you can chew, says Ganesha. You should come up with an innovative way of expressing love if you want to please your lover. You may be strongly influenced by any external stimulus and will be in a mood to enchant your beloved. However, your relationship will be smooth if you are less possessive. You will be working very hard today. You should avoid outside food as your immune system would be weak. As you are likely to get stressed today, so try to do more of extra curricular activities to reduce your stress. In the second half of the day, someone might want to partner with you and start a venture or start a project. Good idea ! Say ‘yes’ to the opportunity as it can help boost your finances considerably. It will be difficult to keep up with the pace of the day. Time will pass very quickly but you will be buried in the piles of work. You may have to spend quality time for planning. Prioritising work will be easy, feels Ganesha.

Being open-minded with your beloved about your likes and dislikes, as much as about your ambitions, will be crucial today. You will feel very energetic. Ganesha advises you to give enough respect to customs and traditions, and pay heed to calls of higher education. People will appreciate the connoisseur in you. You want to stay away from creative ideas in the relationship and will enjoy a romantic evening with your beloved. You seem to give more importance on the things and not your spouse. You may need to welcome changes to your preferences. The first half of the day is going to be good. Your performance at work will be very good. However, things may change in the second half of the day. You may not be able to resist against odds in the second half, feels Ganesha. Ganesha feels that during second half of the day, you may have sudden expenses on the account of health, accidents or you may be caught in debt trap. You will have to fall back on your savings. Day to day activities will take up most of your time today. You may be planning short business trips and hence may have to reshuffle work schedules. You need to be confident enough to please your clients. You may have to face some challenges. So be prepared.

Ganesha says work related to the government will prove beneficial to you today. Your relations with your siblings will improve. You maybe able to spend a happy time with your close friends. You may have to give equal attention to your love life. Make sure that your sweetheart does not complain. You should be a bit disciplined about your relationship. Sharing your thoughts with your partner may make the situations easy, says Ganesha. You should try to be objective while dealing with odds. If you become subjective, it will generate emotional stress. In second half of the day, you will be able to prove your metal at work. Some creative activity will be boosting your morale. You will just want to deal with routine and keep all the financial pressures or tensions aside for a while. Once you are through with your routine jobs, you will take up finances as subject of the day. Domestic responsibilities may draw your attention when you are in the office today. You will be energetic and increase your speed to finish the pending works. You may not want to spend the long hours in office. So you will wrap up the work early.

Your day is equally divided between your near & dear ones and your responsibilities towards the elderly people. As you are sensitive, you may go out of your way to help them. For all those who are eagerly waiting to begin the new chapter in life, a marriage proposal is due during the evening time, foresees Ganesha. Life is smooth on the domestic front. You are confident to maintain a peaceful relationship. You may be ready to fulfill your dreams. Expect your partner to trust your instinct. You will rejuvenate your mind by spending a joyous time with your family. You will be in a position to complete several important work today. Your mind will work in an efficient manner today. However, you will have to manage your mood swings,says Ganesha. Try staying away from emotional ups and downs today. You shouldn’t let money spoil your relations; thus you should try to be bit liberal, loosen your purse-strings and spend necessary money on family members, if need be. Today is not good for money matters. You will experience a considerable change in the office. Your efforts and sincerity will be applauded. Colleagues will come to you with their problem and you will not say ‘no’ to anyone. You will maintain good ethics, welcome change in order to achieve the desired results.

Kids and their demands top your priority list today, says Ganesha. They will come out with flying colours in academics and related activities. Today, you will also plan your schedule in a way that you will give a lot of time to meditation and yoga. A peaceful day, a peaceful you!. You may become philosophical in the evening and spend a nice time discussing some betterment in your home atmosphere with your better half. You want to bring peace and pleasure to your room so that you satisfy your loved one. You will be totally focussed today. However, you may be trying very hard to balance between personal and professional fronts today. You will succeed in achieving all the targets because of good planetary positions and good health, says Ganesha. It’s a good day. You will be interested in establishing long-term stability so that you can have that ‘desired most leisure time in life’. Well well, that doesn’t happen overnight. You need to work harder. You may give yourself to work even if it leaves you feeling dragged out. Your presence of mind will remain strong today, feels Ganesha. Your intelligence and ability to take quick decisions will help you meet the targets on time.

Love will be on your mind today. Going down the memory lane will make you cherish some golden moments spent with friends and family members. You will call up an old friends and share those memories. On the professional front, you will achieve major milestones, predicts Ganesha. All in all, it is a good day for you today. You may expect your sweetheart to attract you today. Exchange of gifts is likely to occur. You will enjoy a smooth communication. The exciting exchange of words will keep your romance strong, feels Ganesha. Ensuring a long-term relationship will not be difficult, says Ganesha. You will have very high confidence today, says Ganesha. But don’t get angry over small issues. Overall, you will be in cheerful mood all the while. You will also get a sense of accomplishment. You will control your emotions better today. If you are in the family business, family members will stand by you when you need them financially and morally. If you are looking for increasing your net worth, your network will be the key, says Ganesha. You will work with enthusiasm. Extended office hours will leave you exhausted, feels Ganesha. You may even pressurize your colleagues to put in more effort and they may not like this. It’s better to follow a natural flow as you will expect natural results.

It is time to catch up some friends and have a good time. You discuss a variety of topics with them, ranging from music to spirituality, from social system to human values, and from politics to career prospects. In the evening, you will spend some romantic moments with sweetheart, may go out for dinner or just enjoy each other’s company, says Ganesha. Love seems to be great in the arms of your sweetheart. Ganesha says you would do wrong if you plan to stay away from your sweetheart. It’s time to have patience and understand your loved one. Managing the emotional stress will be easy when you will be with your beloved. While your health may not be good in the first half of the day, it is going to improve in the second half. In the second half, you will be able to reach to many good logical conclusions, says Ganesha. Financial crisis will be sorted out only if you remain composed and cool. Second half of the day indicates that advises coming from people in your group (online or offline) will be very useful. Your stars are not in your luck this morning. However, as the day progresses, you will realize that planetary positions are changing and luck is supporting you. You may put a lot of effort for petty matters in the morning but the evening will compensate for everything.

You health and mood will be good today as you will begin to reap the fruits the seeds sown in the past. You will experience happiness and satisfaction from business and returns during the evening. Make the most of the perfect alignment of planets is what is Ganesha’s advice. You might go for a few practical decisions in personal life and they will definitely be for the betterment of your relationship. Your sweetheart will emotionally keep you happy. You may be the one who is courageous to your partner. Overall, a harmonious relationship is on the cards. You will be in good health and mood today. Even your mood swings will be very much under control. You will also be able to build new relations. Ganesha suggets you to consume liquid diet to keep up your energy level. Ganesha feels that today you must avoid taking money on credit. It might adversely affect your financial graph for a long time. However, this is a good time to purchase things on EMIs. Everybody will praise your work in office. Your superiors will be impressed and you can definitely hope for a promotion. You may like to bring some positive change in the work environment or procedures. You will feel happy to share your views, says Ganesha.
